summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str(obj) with sep and calls self.print once with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, crop off, highlight defaulting to True). Added tests in tests/test_console.py after test_print_style (test_out plus test_out_no_objects, markup/emoji, containers, not_cropped, style, highlight variants, render_hook), with RenderHook and Text imported at top. Added "Added Console.out" CHANGELOG bullet under 9.0.0 Added, and a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after Logging. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only. test_out_render_hook asserts loosely (startswith "foo\n" and contains "HOOK") because the exact rendering of a Text hook output was not confirmed.
